DealerVehDefSearchableField.name: DealerVehDefSearchableField
DealerVehDefSearchableField.description: Represents information about dealerships selling and, or, servicing vehicles for location-based searches. Helps customers find nearby dealer locations for vehicle-related purchases and services.

BodyType.description: The body type or style of the vehicle, such as hatchback or coupe.

BusinessBrandId.description: The business brand related to a vehicle model.

BusinessBrandName.description: The name of the business brand.

BusinessPartnerType.description: The type of dealer that’s associated with a vehicle or its parts.

BusinessProfileId.description: The business profile related to a dealer's account.

DealerAccountId.description: The account related to a dealer's business profile.

DealerPhone.description: The phone number of the dealer.

DealerServices.description: The list of services offered by a dealer.

FuelSource.description: The power source used in a vehicle, such as gasoline or diesel.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

MakeName.description: The make name of a vehicle.

ModelName.description: The model name of a vehicle.

ModelYear.description: The model year of a vehicle.

ProductFamily.description: The unique code of a product related to a vehicle model.

ProductId.description: The product related to a seller product.

ProductName.description: The name of the product related to a vehicle model.

RegionName.description: The name of the region where the dealer operates from.

SellerProductId.description: The seller product related to a product.

SellerRole.description: The role of the seller related to the product, such as for sales or for service.

ServiceTerritoryAddress.description: The address of the service territory related to a dealer's business profile.

ServiceTerritoryCity.description: The city of the service territory related to a dealer's business profile.

ServiceTerritoryCountry.description: The country of the service territory related to a dealer's business profile.

ServiceTerritoryCountryCode.description: The country code of the service territory related to a dealer's business profile.

ServiceTerritoryId.description: The service territory related to a dealer's business profile.

ServiceTerritoryName.description: The name of the service territory related to a dealer's business profile.

TestDriveVehicleDefinition.description: The vehicle definition of a vehicle that's available for a test drive at a dealership.

TransmissionSystem.description: The transmission type of the vehicle, such as manual or automatic.

TrimType.description: The trim type of the vehicle model, such as DX, GT, or LS.

VehicleDefinitionId.description: The vehicle definition related to a product.

VehicleProductName.description: The name of the vehicle definition related to a vehicle.

VehicleServiceType.description: The list of work type groups related to a dealer.
